name: Dalmoth (Agra Style)
instructions: 1. Soak the whole masoor dal for 8-10 hours, then drain and pat completely dry on a cloth. 2. Prepare a stiff dough with besan, water, a pinch of turmeric, and salt. 3. Deep fry the dried lentils until crispy and drain on paper towels. 4. Use a sev press to drop the besan dough directly into hot oil and fry until golden. 5. While the ingredients are still warm, toss them together in a large bowl. 6. Sprinkle the mixture of chaat masala, black salt, chili powder, and amchur over the hot snack to ensure the spices coat the surface evenly. 7. Allow to cool completely before storing in an airtight container.
description: Dalmoth is an iconic snack originating from Agra. It is famously known for its signature spicy, salty, and tangy flavor profile. Historically associated with the legendary sweet and snack shops of Agra, it is a staple tea-time accompaniment across North India.
